lines.description:
THIRD PAYMENT — 10% OF THE CONTRACT VALUE
Third instalment against our approved quotation QUT/DCTS/SQ144/2026 for the enlargement of the freezer room to 18.00 x 14.00 x 6.00 m (1,512.00 cbm) at –18 °C to –22 °C, falling due during the works as the third of the four stages agreed between us.
The works covered by this contract comprise 636.00 sqm of new 100 mm PUF sandwich panel — 384.00 sqm to all four walls and 252.00 sqm to the ceiling — with all aluminium coving, corner angles, silicone sealing, panel support steel, fasteners and accessories; the new sliding cold room door 2000 x 2500 mm with heated frame, track, rollers, guides and internal safety release; and the refrigeration works, being the new BITZER (Germany) LH135/4JE-22Y-40P condensing unit of 22 HP with its Güntner (Germany) GACC RX 050.2-2SN-JNA7E unit cooler, the re-commissioning of your two existing Dorin 15 HP units, the copper pipework with Armaflex insulation, the electric defrost and insulated drain lines, the control panel with all safeties, the internal lighting and the complete electrical works, followed by pressure testing, evacuation, charging, testing, commissioning and handover.
Contract value QAR 150,000.00 — this invoice covers the third instalment of 10%.

notes: ACCOUNT POSITION. Contract value QAR 150,000.00, payable in four stages as agreed between us. Received to date QAR 120,000.00 — the 50% advance of QAR 75,000.00, settled in full on 17-11-2026 across six transfers and receipted under RCT-302, 303, 304, 306 and 309/2026; and the 30% second instalment of QAR 45,000.00, settled on 20-11-2026 by transfer IB1A14575587 and receipted under RCT-317/2026. This invoice: the third instalment of 10%, QAR 15,000.00. Remaining after this invoice: QAR 15,000.00, being the final 10%.

AGREED PAYMENT SCHEDULE. 50% advance QAR 75,000.00; 30% QAR 45,000.00 after installation of the sandwich panel; 10% QAR 15,000.00 during the works; and 10% QAR 15,000.00 final. This schedule replaces the stages printed in our quotation and is the schedule on which both of us have proceeded throughout.

WITH OUR THANKS, WHICH ARE GENUINELY MEANT. Eight transfers have been made on this contract and not one reminder has been sent. We are conscious that you have settled every stage promptly, and ahead of us in more than one case. We shall keep you informed in writing as the works proceed and you are welcome at any time to ask us for the position on site.

Payment due on presentation of this invoice. Payment may be made by cheque or bank transfer to the account shown above; cheques to be crossed "A/C Payee Only" and drawn strictly in favour of the account name given, which is THE NEW DOHA KITCHEN EQUIPMENT SERVICES W.L.L. with no word between Equipment and Services. Kindly quote invoice INV-321/2026 as the reference.

THE FLOOR REMAINS OUTSIDE THIS CONTRACT. No floor panel, insulated floor build-up, under-floor ventilation or under-floor heating is included, and the room is installed on your existing floor. On a room of 1,512 cbm held at –18 °C to –22 °C over a slab, frost heave is a real and well-documented risk over time. We repeat this for the fifth time in writing and should be grateful for your written instruction either way; we remain ready to survey the slab and quote an insulated floor or an under-floor ventilation system.

THE TWO EXISTING DORIN 15 HP UNITS CARRY NO WARRANTY FROM US. They are your own equipment, re-used and re-commissioned under this contract. We warrant our re-commissioning work, but not the condensing units themselves. WARRANTY on our own supply: twelve (12) months on the cold room panels, the new door and our workmanship from the date of handover, and twelve (12) months on the new BITZER compressor, the Güntner unit cooler, the electrical components and the controls from the date of commissioning. Excludes damage from misuse, power surge, improper voltage, water ingress, unauthorised modification or the absence of routine maintenance.
This invoice is issued against our quotation QUT/DCTS/SQ144/2026 as approved and company-stamped by you on 06-11-2026 and is subject to its terms.
